title: Ligands by denticity
caption: A ligand donates a lone pair to the metal. Ammonia donates one (monodentate); ethane-1,2-diamine and ethanedioate donate two (bidentate); EDTA⁴⁻ donates six (hexadentate), wrapping round the metal ion. Multidentate ligands form more stable complexes (the chelate effect).
alt: Ammonia, ethane-1,2-diamine, ethanedioate and EDTA⁴⁻ with their donor atoms.
description: EDTA⁴⁻: two nitrogens and four oxygens.
